description: Directory traversal in detectProject() has no depth limit and could infinite loop or traverse outside workspace if symlinks create cycles. The while condition `currentDir !== path.parse(currentDir).root` protects against root but not symlink cycles.
suggestion: Add a max-depth limit (e.g., 50) and track visited directories to prevent symlink cycles.

description: Polling interval setInterval runs every 2 seconds unconditionally, even when app is backgrounded or user is inactive. No cleanup on window blur / app suspend. Wastes CPU and filesystem I/O.
suggestion: Use requestAnimationFrame or visibilitychange-aware polling, or switch to fs.watch() for log file changes instead of polling.

description: fs.readdir() reads entire session directory on every poll (every 2s). With many session files, this is O(n) filesystem operations. No caching of file list between polls.
suggestion: Use fs.watch() on the sessions directory to detect new/modified files, or at minimum cache file list and only re-read on change events.

description: Entire log file re-read and re-parsed on every poll (every 2s). For large sessions with many log entries, this re-processes all history repeatedly. O(n) per poll where n grows over session lifetime.
suggestion: Track last read position (file size/offset) and only read new lines. Or use fs.watch() to trigger incremental reads.

description: Empty catch block swallows all errors when reading settings.json - no logging or diagnostics. If settings.json is malformed JSON, isConnected silently becomes false with no indication why.
suggestion: Add console.error or debug logging in catch block to aid troubleshooting connection issues.

description: stdin read loop concatenates chunks to string without size limit. A malicious or buggy caller could stream unlimited data, causing OOM. No max payload size enforcement.
suggestion: Add a hard limit on accumulated payload size (e.g., 10MB) and abort if exceeded.

description: JSON.parse() in try-catch exits silently on invalid JSON. This is correct for hook robustness but makes debugging impossible - no error output to stderr to indicate payload format issues.
suggestion: Log parse errors to stderr (not stdout) so they appear in Claude Code logs but don't break the hook protocol.

description: TRUNCATE_THRESHOLD (2000) is a magic number hardcoded as const but used in multiple places. HEAD_CHAR_BUDGET (1200) + TAIL_CHAR_BUDGET (600) = 1800 < 2000, meaning truncation always reduces output - but the relationship is opaque.
suggestion: Group constants into a config object with comments explaining the budget math: threshold > head + tail.

description: omittedAfter calculation has a bug: `middleLines.length - (headEndIdx + anchorBlocks[anchorBlocks.length - 1].endIdx - headEndIdx)` simplifies to `middleLines.length - anchorBlocks[last].endIdx`, but endIdx is already relative to middleLines, so this is correct. However, the expression is overly complex and error-prone.
suggestion: Simplify to `middleLines.length - anchorBlocks[anchorBlocks.length - 1].endIdx` and add a comment.

description: InteractivePrompt uses useInput but does NOT handle the input - it only clears query on Enter. The actual query text is never processed, submitted, or passed anywhere. The input is effectively a no-op.
suggestion: Add onSubmit callback prop to InteractivePrompt and invoke it with query.trim() on Enter. Wire up to command handling in parent.

description: COMMANDS array is hardcoded but '/connect', '/stats', '/hooks', '/clear' suggest these should be actual CLI commands. No integration with commander program from cli.ts.
suggestion: Either make QuickCommands dynamic by reading from command registry, or remove if purely decorative.

description: buildTextRows() called on every render. It reconstructs the same static strings each time. No memoization.
suggestion: Move textRows to module-level constant or use useMemo. The banner never changes.

description: Uses chalk.hex() for colors but ink components accept color props directly. Mixing chalk with ink's color system is redundant and adds a dependency.
suggestion: Use ink's color prop: <Text color="#FFF4E6">●</Text> instead of chalk.hex(DOTS[0])('●').

description: execFileSync with user-controlled cwd (process.cwd()) - if cwd is manipulated via symlinks or path traversal, could execute git in unintended directories. However, cwd is process.cwd() so limited risk.
suggestion: Validate cwd is within expected workspace before execFileSync. Use resolved absolute paths.

description: getWorkspaceContext() runs synchronously on every render (called from Provider). execFileSync blocks the main thread. With useStdin() in App, this runs once on mount but any re-render of Provider would re-execute.
suggestion: Move getWorkspaceContext() outside component or memoize with useMemo. Currently only called once since Provider doesn't re-render, but fragile.

description: InputHandler registers Ctrl+R handler but does nothing (placeholder comment). Keyboard shortcut advertised in ShortcutBar but non-functional.
suggestion: Either implement expand-all functionality or remove the handler and shortcut bar mention.

description: InputHandler returns null but is conditionally rendered. This works but is an anti-pattern - better to not render the component at all via early return in App.
suggestion: Move the isRawModeSupported check inside InputHandler or use early return in App to avoid mounting null.

description: Entry point is minimal but lacks error boundary. Any render error in App crashes the entire CLI without graceful handling.
suggestion: Wrap render in try-catch or use React error boundary for graceful degradation.

description: useHookState combines two unrelated concerns: (1) project detection/connection state, (2) session stats polling. Violates single responsibility. Testing and reuse are harder.
suggestion: Split into useProjectDetection() and useSessionStats() hooks. Compose in WorkspaceContextProvider.

description: WorkspaceContextProvider calls getWorkspaceContext() (sync, blocking) during render. Should be in useEffect or useMemo to avoid blocking on mount.
suggestion: Move getWorkspaceContext() to useEffect with empty deps and set state, or use useMemo if keeping sync.
